{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(qa_orders.head())

# Filter for completed orders only
completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute mean revenue of completed orders, excluding QA and refunded
mean_revenue = completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after cleaning and filtering): {mean_revenue}")"}
